verdict.rationale: Supabase is built on Postgres and exposes standard export paths (pg_dump-based backups, migrations in version control, self-hosting via Docker Compose, REST/GraphQL APIs, CLI), which together enable data portability and self-hosting rather than lock-in. However, there is no explicit first-party 'export all your data' feature or documented full-account data export tool, and community evidence flags real friction with backups (pg_dump causing downtime) and migrations being a weak point. missing for 10: an explicit bulk/one-click data export feature or documented data-portability guarantee, independent confirmation of a clean full export+exit workflow, and resolution of the backup/migration pain points raised by users.
